caption: The drawing depicts a single object made of metal, consisting of a long, thin shaft with a circular loop at one end and a complex, irregularly shaped structure at the other. The structure at the left end is formed from reddish-brown metal, with two rounded, parallel openings separated by a solid central section. Three thin, straight rods extend from the left structure, merging into a single shaft that continues to the opposite end, where the metal is shaped into a circular loop. The colors used are primarily shades of brown and reddish-brown, giving a metallic, oxidized appearance to the object. The background is an off-white or cream color, and the object is centered horizontally in the composition. The name "ROSE CAMPBELL" is written in small, capitalized letters near the lower center-right of the image.
title: Branding Iron
